connections.label: Central Intelligence Agency
connections.note: Congress fixed this in statute. Public Law 105-272 sec. 309 provides that 'the headquarters compound of the Central Intelligence Agency located in Langley, Virginia, shall be known and designated as the George Bush Center for Intelligence'. Langley is a neighbourhood of McLean in Fairfax County, and is a different place from Langley Air Force Base at Hampton, Virginia.

connections.label: The MITRE Corporation
connections.note: MITRE names McLean, Virginia as one of its two principal locations, with four buildings on Colshire Drive. McLean is where the defence and intelligence FFRDC work sits: the NSF master list registers the National Security Engineering Center, the Center for Advanced Aviation System Development, the Center for Enterprise Modernization and HSSEDI at McLean.

connections.label: Office of the Director of National Intelligence
connections.note: The Liberty Crossing intelligence campus, which houses ODNI alongside the National Counterterrorism Center, is in McLean, Virginia: an official federal record titles the President's 27 July 2021 remarks there 'Remarks at the Liberty Crossing Intelligence Campus and an Exchange With Reporters in McClean, Virginia' - the misspelling is the record's own. That record fixes where the campus is; it does not itself designate ODNI's headquarters, which is why this is tier 2.

sources.name: Compilation of Presidential Documents, DCPD-202100617, 'Remarks at the Liberty Crossing Intelligence Campus and an Exchange With Reporters in McClean, Virginia'

desc: McLean, Virginia is where four of MITRE's six FFRDCs are registered on the NSF's master list - the National Security Engineering Center (primary location reassigned here in 2025), the Center for Advanced Aviation System Development, the Center for Enterprise Modernization, and the Homeland Security Systems Engineering and Development Institute. It sits inside the Northern Virginia intelligence corridor between CIA headquarters at Langley and the Pentagon. MITRE's other headquarters is in Bedford, Massachusetts, adjacent to Hanscom Air Force Base and MIT Lincoln Laboratory, the corporation's point of origin. The two-campus structure is itself the story: the Massachusetts campus is the engineering inheritance from Lincoln Laboratory and SAGE; the Virginia campus is where the defence and intelligence customer relationships live.
